title: Federal FISMA reporting: Fiscal Year 2021
publisher: Executive Office of the President, Office of Management and Budget
summary: OMB reported seven major incidents in FY 2021 and documented the federal response to SolarWinds and other material events. The report establishes the pre-automation baseline for this three-report series.
key_findings: OMB reported seven major incidents in FY 2021 and documented the federal response to SolarWinds and other material events.
Method: Annual agency reporting under FISMA, compiled by OMB.
Denominator: Federal civilian executive-branch agencies and reported federal information systems, as defined for each fiscal year.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the federal fisma reporting series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for institutional AI and cybersecurity system performance.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: The report establishes the pre-automation baseline for this three-report series.
The observation is bounded to United States federal government and the stated period.
The denominator is Federal civilian executive-branch agencies and reported federal information systems, as defined for each fiscal year.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
